第9章 三皇子妃沐倾城（第1页）
叶海走后，叶凡继续留在院子内修炼。
白天晒着太阳，吸收日光提升修为。
晚上，则进入镇天界，专注修炼武技。
除九阳焚天剑法外，亦强化了炽阳手。
而今武技皆熟练了不少，修为亦快突破了。
转眼，就到了天武书院新生试炼的日子。
叶海话音自院外传来，随即走进院内，看到叶凡懒洋洋地躺在躺椅上，忍不住劝道，“凡儿，可不能因为有了一点成绩就骄傲自满。永远记得，人外有人，天外有天。天武书院，不乏天才。”
叶海显然不信，觉得叶凡这是死要面子，但也没有要责怪的意思，“修炼累了，休息一会儿没关系，劳逸结合嘛……你不用在爹这逞强。”
叶凡无奈耸肩，知道叶海是误会了。
“走吧，叶瑶在外面等了有一会儿了。”
刚出院子，叶凡目光就被叶瑶吸引了过去。
今日的叶瑶一袭紧身白裙，勾勒出曼妙曲线，尤其胸前那傲人双峰，几乎要将衣料撑破。
阳光洒在她身上，映得其肌肤白皙如玉，而那起伏的曲线更是让人移不开眼。
叶瑶察觉到叶凡的目光，双手抱胸，一声喊话。
叶凡闻言嘴角勾起一抹玩味的笑容，“瑶姐，你这身材，想不看都难啊……”
叶瑶脸一红，抬手作出要打叶凡的架势，“几年没揍你，是不是皮痒了？”

叶凡连忙后退两步，举起双手做投降状。
叶瑶上下打量叶凡，眼神透着几分不屑，“听说你最近长本事了？可别到了天武书院，被人打得满地找牙。”
叶凡咧嘴一笑，“瑶姐放心，我要是被打得满地找牙，一定第一个找你求救。”
叶瑶瞪了叶凡一眼，懒得再搭理，转身对叶海道，“家主，我们这就出发了。”
他对这次的新生试炼，倒是不担心。
叶瑶招呼一声，转身大步朝府外走去。
惹得跟在后面的叶凡忍不住又多看了两眼，低声嘀咕，“这身材，真是要命……”
天武书院的招生，并不局限于皇城。
云隐国境内各大城池，都有一定的名额。
今日，通过招生考核之人齐聚皇城。
叶凡在叶瑶带路下，去往天武书院。
这时，后方传来一阵马蹄声，伴着车轮碾过青石路面的声响。
一匹骏马拉着华丽软轿缓缓驶来，轿身镶嵌着金丝花纹，显得格外奢华。
街道上的人群，纷纷朝着两侧避让。

After Ye Hai left, Ye Fan continued to practice in the yard.
Bask in the sun during the day and absorb the sunlight to improve your cultivation.
At night, he enters the Heaven-Suppressing Realm and concentrates on practicing martial arts.
In addition to the Nine Yang Burning Heaven Sword Technique, the Blazing Sun Hand has also been strengthened.
Now he has become more proficient in martial arts, and his cultivation level is about to reach a breakthrough.
In the blink of an eye, it was the day of the trial for the new students of Tianwu Academy.
Ye Hai's voice came from outside the hospital. He walked into the hospital and saw Ye Fan lazily lying on the recliner. He couldn't help but advise, "Fan'er, don't be complacent just because you have some achievements. Always remember, there are people outside the world, and there is a sky outside the world. There is no shortage of geniuses in Tianwu Academy."
Ye Hai obviously didn't believe it. He felt that Ye Fan was trying to save face, but he didn't mean to blame him. "It doesn't matter if you are tired from practicing. It doesn't matter if you take a break. You should balance work and rest... You don't have to show off to me."
Ye Fan shrugged helplessly, knowing that Ye Hai had misunderstood.
"Let's go, Ye Yao has been waiting outside for a while."
As soon as he left the yard, Ye Fan's eyes were attracted to Ye Yao.
Today, Ye Yao is wearing a tight-fitting white dress, which outlines her graceful curves, especially the proud breasts on her chest, which almost burst the fabric.
The sun shone on her body, making her skin as white as jade, and her undulating curves made people unable to take their eyes away.
Ye Yao noticed Ye Fan's gaze, crossed her arms and shouted.
When Ye Fan heard this, a playful smile appeared at the corner of his mouth, "Sister Yao, with your figure, it's hard not to look at it..."
Ye Yao blushed and raised her hand as if to hit Ye Fan, "I haven't beaten you in a few years. Are you itchy?"
Ye Fan quickly took two steps back and raised his hands in a gesture of surrender.
Ye Yao looked Ye Fan up and down with a bit of disdain in her eyes, "I heard that you have become more capable recently? Don't go to Tianwu Academy and get beaten all over the ground."
Ye Fan grinned and said, "Sister Yao, don't worry, if I get beaten all over the place and find my teeth, I will be the first one to come to you for help."
Ye Yao glared at Ye Fan and was too lazy to respond. She turned to Ye Hai and said, "Master, we are leaving now."
He is not worried about this freshman trial.
Ye Yao greeted, turned around and strode out of the house.
Ye Fan, who was following behind, couldn't help but take another look and murmured in a low voice, "This figure is really terrible..."
Tianwu Academy's enrollment is not limited to the Imperial City.
All major cities in Yunyin Kingdom have certain quotas.
Today, those who passed the admissions assessment gathered in the imperial city.
Ye Fan, led by Ye Yao, went to Tianwu Academy.
At this time, there was a sound of horse hooves coming from behind, accompanied by the sound of wheels running over the bluestone pavement.
A horse pulled a gorgeous soft sedan slowly approaching. The sedan's body was inlaid with gold filigree patterns, making it look particularly luxurious.
The crowds on the street moved to both sides to avoid it.
